requirements.name: Identity and isolation
acceptance: An inactive user or membership is denied even with another role row and a previously issued session.
Cross-account and unassigned-facility reads, writes, joins, exports, object paths and dashboard aggregates are denied server-side.
Technical administrators do not gain implicit scientific, signature or release authority.

requirements.name: Document integrity
acceptance: Review approval binds to the exact immutable revision and checksum; a changed draft loses that approval.
Creating a replacement draft leaves the released version current until controlled replacement release.
A package cannot expose restricted child files; direct storage access is denied without current audience authorization.
Preservation holds block destruction separately from visibility restrictions.

requirements.name: Controlled authority
acceptance: Messages and AI outputs can create proposals but cannot change approved scope, caps, samples, signed terms or released files.
Effective approved amendments govern the amended domain while original records and approval chains remain available.
Retries and concurrency do not cause duplicate signatures, commitments or conflicting active revisions.

requirements.name: Resilience and data lifecycle
acceptance: Restore a representative backup into an isolated environment and reconcile database records with private objects and audit history.
A failed migration or partial integration has an exercised recovery path; no untested destructive down-migration is assumed safe.
Record measured recovery and performance results against explicitly approved targets.
Candidate release includes dependency and secret scanning, privileged-admin MFA evidence and independent outside security/code review with material findings resolved or explicitly dispositioned.
Operational errors, uptime checks, audit failures and admin alerts are observed with a named support owner before real client use.

requirements.name: Usability and accessibility
acceptance: Simple, enterprise, internal and vendor roles complete representative real workflows on keyboard and supported phone/desktop sizes.
Loading, empty, permission-denied, stale-edit, validation, upload-retry and partial-failure states are actionable and preserve entered work.
Unknown, unmeasured and unapproved information is visibly distinguished from zero, compliant and complete.

requirements.name: Moldo independent operation
acceptance: Moldo-only staff and managers have no OS membership by integration alone.
OS outage, connector revocation, duplicate or out-of-order messages do not corrupt or stop ordinary Moldo operations.
Enterprise clients and group managers see only their authorized and appropriately released projection.
Per-engagement commercial owner, data owner and identity mapping can be exported and reconciled without merging databases.

requirements.name: No-PHI and runtime AI
acceptance: Suspected PHI is quarantined and excluded from AI processing under the already-decided no-PHI posture.
Untrusted documents and messages cannot supply agent instructions or elevate permissions.
Runtime AI outputs carry sources and review state; technical sign-off remains an authorized human action.

requirements.name: Durable and verifiable continuation
acceptance: The complete product scope, dependencies, decisions and source references are machine-checked.
Evidence is invalidated by changed input files, test commands, environment identity or logs; a chat summary is never test evidence.
Checkpoint and importer preserve observed state and refuse unsupported remote-save claims.
